name: Provisions Deli & Bottle Shop
tagline: 30 rotating craft taps, hundreds of curated bottles, and gourmet artisan sandwiches
description: The epicenter for beer aficionados and epicureans in Orange. Provisions pairs an extensive 30-tap craft draft wall with refrigerated vaults containing rare sours, IPAs, and European vintages. Order gourmet grilled paninis, artisanal cheese and charcuterie boards, and enjoy seating indoors or in the bustling back patio.
historicNote: Situated in a revitalized 1910 retail storefront featuring original high ceilings, exposed brick masonry, and industrial steel accents.

specials.title: Panini & Pint Lunch Pair
